Now you will face the consequences of your actions!|audio = TheNightmareRealmWave20.ogg|[[Conserver (Narrator)|Conserver]] on Wave 20 ([[The Nightmare Realm]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Conserver''' was the final boss of [[The Nightmare Realm]], second night of the [[Hexscape Event]]. It had a high amount of health but walked much slower than every enemy that appeared before it. It was also a [[Boss]] enemy, granting it multiple immunities. The '''Conserver''' had four abilities: #The first was ''Endbringer'', which was only activated if all the [[The Nightmare Realm#Objective|Super Computer parts]] were not fixed before the '''Conserver''' spawned. This made the '''Conserver''' have its health multiplied by 7.5, with the base health going from 80,000 to 600,000 in the Easy difficulty and from 400,000 to 3,000,000 in the Hard difficulty. #Its second ability was ''Spirit Release'', which made it fire out multiple skulls from its body. These stunned towers for 3 seconds while also applying a 40% [[Scared Debuff]] for 10 seconds, including non-humanoid towers. Towers would also have ghosts appear out of them. #The third ability was ''Summon'', which summoned ten [[Forsaken Skull]] with a 0.3 delay between each and seven [[Bloated]] [[Hex Revenant]]s with a 0.8 delay, while also healing itself by 1,000. #Its last ability, ''Void Smash'' made it slam its club on the ground, creating multiple thorns that stunned any tower hit for 4 seconds. ==Appearance== The '''Conserver's''' body was made entirely out of what appears to be molten slag or lava. It wore black armor, which covered most of its body. Its helmet had multiple horns. Additionally, it had spikes seen around its head that resembled teeth. On its back, it had the Artificial [[God Cube]]. It wielded a black club with neon red insides, which had three eyes on it. ==Strategy== *Super Computer should be fixed by purchasing every single [[Super Computer Parts]] before the '''Conserver''' spawns. Otherwise, its health will be multiplied by 7.5, making it extremely hard to beat if playing on the Easy difficulty, but outright impossible to kill in the Hard difficulty. *High DPS towers, like the [[Engineer]], [[Accelerator]], [[Ranger]] or [[Minigunner]], are great choices against the '''Conserver'''. While expensive, they can be upgraded quite easily as the '''Conserver''' gives {{Money|40,000}} every 5% health lost. **Because of this, more expensive towers like the [[Turret]] or [[Gatling Gun]] can also be afforded, despite their high costs. **The [[DJ Booth]] can be useful at reducing their upgrade costs, making it easier to afford them, while also boosting their damage and range. ***The [[Commander]] can also be used to boost the DPS of your towers. *The '''Conserver''' can reduce tower range by 40% for multiple seconds with its ''Spirit Release'' ability. **This can be partially mitigated using the [[DJ Booth]]'s [[Range Buff]]s, with its purple track providing the biggest buff. *The [[Medic]] can be useful at cleansing stuns from towers with its ability, though it cannot be used to remove debuffs applied by the '''Conserver'''. *The [[Golden Cowboy]] and [[Cowboy]] can be great methods of affording expensive towers with high DPS. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- !
